Q: 'contenteditable' change events A:

I've modified some of the code available here into a jQuery plugin, so it is in a reusable form, primarily to satisfy my needs, but others may appreciate a simpler interface to jumpstart using contenteditable tags.

The plugin has been adopted by Makesites.org. Development will continue from jQuery contentEditable.

Q: How should I model department assignment history for faculty members in a relational database? A:

Drop the FK back on Faculty, it just creates a dependency and makes inserts a pain. instead just keep everything in dept_assignment with a start_date/end_date, and treat current dept as the row where end_date is null.

It's just two separate 1-to-many relationships feeding into the assignment table.

For the "exactly one dept at a time" rule, a plain FK can't enforce that once you are keeping history which means using a partial unique index on faculty_id where end_date is null, that will stop anyone from having two open assignments at once.

Q: Animations on iOS16 WidgetKit A:

It is actually possible to create smooth widget animations without using GIFs or any third-party APIs! It can be done entirely in pure SwiftUI and nothing else. I managed to implement this approach and you can see it working live in my app, "Clock Widgets HomeScreen", on the App Store

Q: Unix-style tools on Windows? A:

2026 Update (non-extensive list)

  • uutils/coreutils, uutils/findutils and uutils/diffutils exist now. As of writing this, the installation steps are a bit hard to find (https://uutils.org/)
  • When it comes to package managers, the 3 major ones are chocolatey, scoop, and, from Windows version 1809 onwards, winget
  • edit can generally be used as a nano replacement. It's an internal part of Windows since update 25H2. The newest version can be installed using the GitHub repo or any of the previously mentioned package managers
